subject: Request: activity log snapshot & proof collection plan for SOC2 intake
messages:
From: Alex Chen <security@clearpathhealth.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 03 May 2026 08:12:00 +0000
Subject: Audit evidence request — activity logs & admin trail (SOC 2 intake)

Jordan —

Thanks again for the quick onboarding call this morning. ClearPath is kicking off a SOC 2 readiness review and our auditor has asked for a compact set of artifacts to validate admin activity and operational telemetry. Can you confirm whether Redwood can produce the following as a single "snapshot package" for an agreed timebox?

Requested items (auditor-specified):
- Admin activity ledger: create/update/delete actions for user accounts, role assignments, and service principals (including actor identity and IP).
- Operator command audit: all console/API actions that change serving or routing policies.
- Authentication events: successful/failed logins, MFA events, SSO assertions with timestamps and session IDs.
- Token/service-key lifecycle: issuance/revocation events.
- Per-request metadata: request id, model, route, latency, and routing decision (region/pool/variant) — sampling accepted but auditor prefers >90% coverage for 7-day window.

Retention window: provide a 7-day contiguous slice around 2026-04-20 to 2026-04-26. Export format: CSV/NDJSON, with manifest and SHA256 checksums.

Constraints/questions on our side: we will need redaction of any user-provided prompt/response payloads before ingest into the auditor's tooling. Also let us know if there are administrative-only fields that cannot be exported.

Attaching the auditor's intake form and the fields they will validate. Can you confirm feasible timeline and whether you need a Data Processing Addendum or special export credentials?

Cheers,
Alex Chen
Security Engineer — ClearPath Health

Attachment: clearpath_request_050326.pdf

From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
To: Alex Chen <security@clearpathhealth.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 03 May 2026 12:30:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Audit evidence request — activity logs & admin trail (SOC 2 intake)

Alex —

Thanks, and appreciate the clear list. We can produce a certified export package that meets the auditor's requirements. High-level plan and notes below:

1) Scope & formats
- We will export admin activity ledger, operator command audit, auth events, token lifecycle, and sampled per-request metadata as NDJSON (preferred) and CSV.
- The manifest will include per-file SHA256 and a short schema description.

2) Redaction strategy
- We will not include customer prompt/response strings. Our export pipeline supports field-level redaction; please review the attached redaction_field_map.csv for default redact rules (PII/PHI-like fields are removed).
- If you need pseudonymized ids instead of removal, we can provide a mapping file under a separate NDA.

3) Coverage and sampling
- For per-request metadata, we can provide 100% for control-plane events and ~93% sampling for data-plane tokens where retention was lower. We will include a sampling_map.json in the manifest that documents sampling logic.

4) Timeline
- Internal ETA: preparation + QA: 3 business days after your sign-off on redaction fields.
- Delivery: SFTP transfer or encrypted Google Drive link (your preference).

5) Export mechanics & credentials
- We will spin an export job that snapshots the internal audit store to an export bucket, sign the manifest, and produce a proof bundle (manifest + checksums + operator signature).

Next steps: please confirm (a) redaction defaults in the attached CSV, (b) preferred delivery method, and (c) whether you want the manifest to include sampling statistics.

Tagging Ben on technical details and Laura for legal/scope.

Best,
Jordan Blake
Senior Compliance Program Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachments: redaction_field_map.csv, export-manifest-template.json

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Alex Chen <security@clearpathhealth.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 04 May 2026 09:05:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Audit evidence request — activity logs & admin trail (SOC 2 intake)

Quick technical notes from the runtime/export side — Alex, fyi: 

- File layouts: admin_activity.ndjson will include one event per line with fields: timestamp, actor_email, actor_type, action, target_id, target_type, ip, request_id, region, extra (JSON blob for low-cardinality metadata). We can also emit admin_activity.csv if required.
- Auth events: auth_events.ndjson contains timestamp, user_id, method, result, session_id, sso_provider, client_ip.
- Operator commands: operator_commands.ndjson includes the command id, actor, before_state, after_state (we redact config blobs by default).
- Proofing: export job will produce signed-manifest.sha256 and signed-manifest.sig (operator PGP signature) for chain-of-custody.
- Redactions: we will replace sensitive text fields with "[REDACTED]"; fields removed entirely will be listed in the manifest. See attached redaction_field_map.csv for defaults — you can mark any field to keep.

Operational caveat: if you request full request bodies or conversation content, that requires customer authorization and per-account opt-in; not allowed under our standard export.

If SFTP, provide a write-only account; for Drive we will push to the folder you provide and redact in-transit with client-side encryption as an extra layer.

Ben
Principal Infra Engineer, Runtime/Exports
Redwood Inference

From: Alex Chen <security@clearpathhealth.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 05 May 2026 10:00:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Audit evidence request — activity logs & admin trail (SOC 2 intake)

Thanks everyone — this is exactly the level of detail we need.

Confirming:
- We accept NDJSON and CSV outputs; manifest + SHA256 checksums + operator signature required.
- Redaction defaults look good; ClearPath will not request request/response payloads.
- Delivery: encrypted Google Drive link (we will send a folder share to drive@clearpathhealth.com).
- Please include sampling statistics in the manifest.

Next: Monica and Jordan, can you send the formal export job schedule and an estimated delivery timestamp once the export is queued? Auditor wants the package by 2026-05-10 EOD.

Appreciate the quick turnaround.

—Alex

Attachment: auditor_intake_ack.pdf
